about: Copy this file to ADOPTION.json in the same folder and fill it in. ADOPTION.json is the tool's own file: the drift check never compares it with the house copy, but it checks its shape. Every other file in this folder is a copy of the house shared-tests folder and is never edited here.

skipped_sets.<set id>: <one line: why the set does not apply to this tool>

not_applicable.<case id>: <one line: why the case can't arise in this tool, such as 'the option's job is to write a .zip'>

known_limits.<case id>: <kind letter C, E or F, a colon, and one line: why it is left; the same line goes in the README's Known limits>
